title: Silver Zoom Card: New Customer Promo - 0% APR on Fuel Purchases
summary: This document describes the Silver Zoom Card new-customer promotion offering 0% APR on fuel purchases for the first year (0% on fuel) for qualified applicants under the promotional window. Eligible accounts opened 2025-09-15 through 2025-12-31; after the promotional fuel period, new fuel purchases and remaining promotional balances accrue interest at 20.99% if carried, and customers must make at least minimum required payments by each statement due date to keep terms in effect.
